description: Unified V̂_i → χ^λ predictor combining the 1-dim product formula (this PR) with the multi-dim operator-valued A^λ_{μν}(I) interface coefficient (refined Sub-lemma 2.1, PR #534).  The 1-dim product formula χ^{1-dim}(β_K) = ∏_i V̂_i^{1-dim} is the scalar specialisation of the operator-valued LR-decomposition formula χ^λ(β_K) = Σ c^λ_{μν} · Tr(A^λ_{μν}(I) · (ρ_μ(β_1) ⊗ ρ_ν(β_2))).  Both closures are unified by Sub-lemma 2.1; the scalar formula handles the 1-dim sector exactly, the operator formula handles the general case (already extracted with residual ≤ 7e-15 across all 11 λ ⊢ 6 in sublemma-2-1-A-operator-extract.witness.json).

data.multi_dim_closure_method: operator-valued A^λ_{μν}(I) interface coefficient from refined Sub-lemma 2.1 (sublemma-2-1-A-operator-extract.witness.json)
data.unification_remark: The 1-dim product formula χ^{1-dim}(β_K) = ∏_i V̂_i^{1-dim} is the scalar specialisation of the operator-valued formula at (μ, ν) both 1-dim: ρ_μ(β_1) ⊗ ρ_ν(β_2) collapses to (∏_i V̂_i^μ in β_1) · (∏_j V̂_j^ν in β_2), and A^λ_{μν}(I) is 1×1 = scalar.  The two closures are therefore unified.
